$comment: Per-FAMILY semantics that block/recipe data cannot convey. One file per profile family (PVC IGLO5, a wood system, an alu system). The agent fills datums/anchors; the engine reads them. This is the ONLY hand-authored file per family — everything else is extracted.

elevation.$comment: Visible face widths used to lay out the front elevation (mm). Measure once per family.

datums.$comment: Co-registration fix. Each atomic profile has its own local origin; this [dx,dy] (mm) is ADDED after the recipe offset so profiles seat correctly in composed sections. Set [0,0] then nudge until the rebate closes. This is what makes the left panel of engine/_proof.png seat cleanly.

anchors.$comment: Semantic reference points/lines per profile, local coords (mm). Only what auto-detection can't infer. Optional.

recipeOverrides.$comment: Add junctions the catalog lacks. Your DXF has mullion_fixed+sash but no mullion_movable+sash; define it here once and the engine resolves movable-mullion windows.
